Activity: Teamwork Plan for Final Project

Discuss the following questions with your team and put the answers in a Markdown file. Upload the Markdown to Canvas for this activity.

Remember that your team will be expected to use Git Flow and Scrum project management for the final project.

  1. What will your team's weekly meeting schedule be? Where will you meet? (You will meet twice a week during class, and we recommend you also meet at least once a week outside of class.)

  2. How will your team communicate with each other? (We recommend setting up a private Slack channel, a text chain, a GroupMe, a WhatsApp, etc.) If you have not already set this up, do so now!

  3. How will your team decide on the set of tasks to be completed by the following week?

  4. How will your team delegate those tasks? If you finish a task during the week, how will you know which task to start on next?

  5. It is expected that you will use Git Flow for your tasks to keep the main branch clean. What steps will be taken before a pull request can be approved to merge into main?

  6. How will your team handle testing? For example, will each team member be responsible for writing and running unit tests of their code before creating a pull request?

  7. If you get stuck on a task (started the task but cannot move forward), what will you do? (more detail beyond just "ask my teammates for help")
